def.label: Twin torpedo tubes
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.8: the space palette's tubes, an 8 s reload and a salvo of two (25 g, 12 km/s of change of speed). The magazine is the fit's, and it persists (CC.7). A warship's screen stops a lone salvo; a hauler's lets one round in two through at range.

def.label: Dual-mode turret laser
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.8 (Q-49-7, Q-49-19, Q-49-24, Q-49-26): offence is short and weak against a hull, for drones, collectors and soft targets, at the 5 s floor. Past 25 km a pulse does under half its close-range damage, and at 120 km a point. Defence stops a torpedo inside 45 km on its own automatic cycle of 4 s (provisional): the longest at which one laser in defence and two rotaries stop a lone salvo at every range measured.

def.label: Short-reach heavy turret laser
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.8: the customs corvette's first laser, heavier and shorter than the turret and as weak against a hull at range. Offence at the 5 s floor; defence on the turret's 4 s automatic cycle (provisional). Its own row, so no fit overrides a number.

def.label: Spinal gun
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.8: the space palette's spinal gun, a 6 s cycle; the fit stows 24 rounds, which persist (CC.7). Point defence and lasers cannot stop its round. A hull that burns during the flight is not where the round was aimed, so dodging stays, and costs her change of speed.

def.label: Low-velocity spinal gun
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.8: the belt raider's low-velocity spinal gun (12 km/s), on the palette's 6 s cycle. Its own row, so no fit overrides a number.

def.label: Point-defense rotary
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.8 (Q-49-10, Q-49-26): automatic by D-35-8, a burst every 0.5 s. Two bursts stop a torpedo, which leaves the tube at an integrity of 100. The envelope is the last 4 km of a torpedo's run (provisional; it was 15 km), so two rotaries alone stop one round of a salvo that arrives at speed, and a hauler's screen leaks.
